```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sccomp)

# sccomp_boxplot will call internal function which will check the cache directory, 
# so we need to set the cache directory before calling sccomp_boxplot.
utils::assignInNamespace("sccomp_stan_models_cache_dir", cache_stan_model_dir, ns="sccomp")

# BayesPrism fractions: RNA.ID + one column per cell type (what 10 reads)
prop_table=fread("fileList1.txt", header=FALSE)
fraction_name=prop_table$V2[1]
fraction_file=prop_table$V1[1]
prefix=fraction_name

meta_table=fread("fileList3.txt", header=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(V3 == fraction_name) |>
  dplyr::select(-V3) 
meta_options=split(meta_table$V1, meta_table$V2)
sample_col=meta_options$sample_col
condition_col=meta_options$condition_col
meta=fread(meta_options$filepath, header=TRUE, data.table=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(c(sample_col, condition_col) %in% colnames(meta)))
```

# Overview boxplot

We performed sccomp analysis to compare cell type compositions across different conditions.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
prop_wide <- fread(fraction_file, data.table=FALSE)
stopifnot(all(prop_wide$RNA.ID %in% meta[[sample_col]]))
print_table(prop_wide, byDT=TRUE, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r results='hide'}
prop_long = prop_wide |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=-RNA.ID, names_to="cell_group", values_to="abundance") |>
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by=setNames(sample_col, "RNA.ID")) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    sample=RNA.ID,
    type=!!sym(condition_col)
  ) |>
  as.data.frame() 

all_estimate = sccomp_estimate( 
  prop_long,
  formula_composition = ~0 + type, # we want to use contrasts, so no intercept
  formula_variability = ~1,
  sample = "sample", 
  cell_group = "cell_group",
  abundance  = "abundance",
  bimodal_mean_variability_association = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  cache_stan_model = normalizePath(cache_stan_model_dir)
) 

no_outlier_estimate = all_estimate |>
                  sccomp_remove_outliers(max_sampling_iterations = 2000, 
                  verbose=FALSE)

all_sccomp_result = no_outlier_estimate |>
                sccomp_test()

all_test_rds = paste0(prefix, ".all.test.rds")
saveRDS(all_sccomp_result, file=all_test_rds)

g = all_sccomp_result |> 
  sccomp_boxplot(factor = "type", remove_unwanted_effects=TRUE) +
  theme(legend.position="right")  
```

```{r}
box_png = paste0(prefix, ".boxplot.png")
ggsave(box_png, g, width=8, height=6, units="in", dpi=300, bg="white")
include_graphics(box_png)
```

The significant differences of comparisons are shown in the following credible intervals plot.

```{r, results="hide"}
comp_tbl=fread("fileList4.txt", header=FALSE, data.table=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::filter(V2 != "covariates" & V2 != "covariances")

if(ncol(comp_tbl) == 3) { # v3 is comparison, v2 is useless
  comp_tbl = comp_tbl |> 
    dplyr::select(-V2) |>
    dplyr::rename(V2=V3)
}

res <- comp_tbl |>
  dplyr::group_by(V2) |>
  dplyr::summarise(values = list(V1)) 

complist <- setNames(res$values, res$V2)            # convert to named list

comp_name= names(complist)[1]
comp_content=""
for(comp_name in names(complist)){
  comp_content=paste0(comp_content, "\n# ", comp_name, "\n\n")

  comp_file=gsub(" ", "_", comp_name)
  groups=complist[[comp_name]]

  contrast=paste0("type", groups[2], "-type", groups[1])

  sccomp_result = no_outlier_estimate |>
                  sccomp_test(contrasts= c(contrast))

  saveRDS(sccomp_result, file=paste0(prefix, ".", comp_file, ".sccomp.rds"))

  pchange <- sccomp_proportional_fold_change(
    no_outlier_estimate,
    formula_composition = ~ type,
    from = groups[1], # from is control group
    to = groups[2] # to is treatment group
  ) |> as.data.frame()
                    
  vis_res = sccomp_result |> 
    dplyr::select(cell_group, c_lower, c_effect, c_upper, c_pH0, c_FDR) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    dplyr::left_join(pchange, by=c("cell_group")) |>
    dplyr::select(cell_group, everything()) |>
    dplyr::arrange(proportion_fold_change, decreasing=TRUE)
  
  result_csv=paste0(prefix, ".", comp_file, ".result.csv")
  write.csv(vis_res, result_csv, row.names=FALSE)

  comp_content=paste(comp_content, getPagedTable(result_csv))

  plots = plot(sccomp_result)

  g = plots$credible_intervals_1D + 
    annotate("text", x=-Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0(groups[1], " high"),
             hjust=0, vjust=-0.5, size=3, fontface="bold") +
    annotate("text", x=Inf, y=Inf, label=paste0(groups[2], " high"),
             hjust=1, vjust=-0.5, size=3, fontface="bold") +
    coord_cartesian(clip="off") +
    theme(axis.title.y=element_blank(),
          axis.text.y=element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
          plot.title = element_blank(),
          plot.margin = margin(t=25, r=10, b=10, l=10))

  g$data = g$data |>
    dplyr::arrange(effect, decreasing=TRUE)
  g$data$cell_group = factor(g$data$cell_group, levels=g$data$cell_group)
  g$data$y_var = factor(g$data$y_var, levels=g$data$y_var)
  credible_intervals_1D_png = paste0(prefix, ".", comp_file, ".credible_intervals_1D.contrast.png")

  height=max(3, nrow(g$data) * 0.2 + 1)
  ggsave(credible_intervals_1D_png, g, width=5, height=height, units="in", dpi=300, bg="white")

  comp_content=paste(comp_content, getFigure(credible_intervals_1D_png))
}
comp_rmd="comp.rmd"
writeLines(comp_content, comp_rmd)
```
